# pvescheduler_placement_fixed (Resource)

Pins VM placement to one explicitly named Proxmox node. The node must exist in the cluster when the resource is created. Changing `node_name` replaces the resource.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node_name` (String) The Proxmox node to place the VM on. Changing this forces a new placement.

### Read-Only

- `cpu_usage_pct` (Number) CPU utilization of the node at time of placement, as a percentage (0-100).
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `memory_usage_pct` (Number) Memory utilization of the node at time of placement, as a percentage (0-100).
